data.title: BET & SWEAT
data.description: Kickoff event with football, volleyball, chess (with Eurechess), long jump, Mario Kart, and the iconic Run and Drink. Spectators can bet their BEDs on players' performances. Win or lose, the hype's guaranteed. ;)

data.title: BREAKFAST & BINGO
data.description: A calm start to a chaotic week. Breakfast on campus to start the day right, then an AW with music, games and prizes to wind down. Good food, good vibes, guaranteed laughs.

data.title: SURPRISE EVENT
data.description: The biggest night of the campaign. More details soon, just trust us, you'll want in. :)

data.title: BDE HOTLINE
data.description: Screening of Casino Royale in the Grand Ballroom, with popcorn, drinks, and a glamorous Bond atmosphere.
